message: Stage Zero began. Repository identity preflight passed. No Jcode, provider, Ruflo, Soup, OmniRoute or Ollama work started.
Windows CI failed the Validate frozen mission step after prior head fa51fd8. Cause: GitHub Windows checkout converted frozen text lines to CRLF, changing SHA-256 hashes stored in the manifest.
Added .gitattributes to pin LF line endings for frozen md/json/jsonl files so manifest hashes are Windows-stable.
